name: Retro Font Word Pen Rat Mod

captions.detailed: This 3D model features a customizable pen design consisting of a long rectangular body with integrated blocky text spelling 'AWESOME' along its length. The front of the pen features a stepped conical tip, and the entire core is hollowed out with a cylindrical channel for a pen refill. Accompanying the main pen body are two separate modular components: a small rectangular end stub and a taller rectangular cap featuring an integrated pocket clip.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable, 3D-printable word pen in OpenSCAD with options to toggle the main pen body, an end stub, and a cap with an optional clip. The pen body should integrate a customizable text string along its length, a tapered tip, and a hollow internal channel for a pen refill, controllable by parameters such as font scale, character spacing, pen length, and inner diameter.
captions.factory: The script defines a 'penword' module that uses the MCAD fonts library to extract character polygons, scales them, and extrudes them using linear_extrude. These extruded letters are unioned with a central rectangular cube body and a tapered pen tip consisting of two cylinders. A central square channel and a round cylinder are then subtracted from this union using the difference operator to create the hollow inner core. Conditional statements (if-blocks) are used to generate the separate modular components: the end stub is constructed using rotated cubes, while the cap and pocket clip are assembled using a combination of cubes and cylinders.
